criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Inspect demographics, purchase and review schemas; validate key uniqueness, join cardinality, missingness, duplicate records, datatypes and target meaning.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Use summary statistics and plots to examine purchase distributions, customer/product group differences, outliers and patterns; interpret observations.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Justify missing-value treatment, encoding, feature creation and leakage prevention; exclude identifiers as predictive measurements unless justified.

criteria.name: Linear Model Building
criteria.guidance: Build a reproducible baseline for Purchase, split data properly, fit preprocessing only on training data and document assumptions.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Report MAE, RMSE and R² on holdout data, interpret error and business patterns, and document limitations without unsupported claims.
